title: From electricity prices to profits: multidimensional probabilistic forecasting for BESS trading
abstract: arXiv:2608.26122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This article examines various methods of constructingmultidimensional probabilistic forecasts of electricity prices. Building on the Multiple Split (MS) method, it incorporates forecast averaging across estimation windows of different lengths and compares its performance with that of other, well-established methods. The research demonstrates that the ensemble representation of the price distribution is particularly useful in battery energy storage system (BESS) management. It enables the direct construction of probabilistic forecasts of daily profits. These forecasts can be used to determine optimal charging and discharging hours, as well as to support risk management decisions. The methods are evaluated using data from the German and Spanish day-ahead electricity markets from 2021-2024. The results indicate that theMS method with averaging (MS-ave) generally outperforms the other considered approaches in terms of Prediction Interval Cov

translated_title: 从电价到利润：面向电池储能系统交易的多维概率预测
translated_abstract: 本文探讨了构建电价多维概率预测的各种方法。基于多重分割（MS）方法，它整合了不同长度估计窗口的预测平均值，并将其与其他成熟方法的性能进行了比较。研究表明，价格分布的集成表示在电池储能系统（BESS）管理中特别有用。它能够直接构建每日利润的概率预测。这些预测可用于确定最优充放电时段，并支持风险管理决策。这些方法使用2021-2024年德国和西班牙日前电力市场的数据进行评估。结果表明，带平均化的MS方法（MS-ave）在预测区间覆盖方面通常优于其他考虑的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多重分割和平均化的多维概率预测方法，能够有效提升电池储能系统的利润预测准确性，并在德国和西班牙市场数据上验证了其优越性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multidimensional probabilistic forecasting method based on multiple split with averaging, which effectively improves profit prediction accuracy for battery energy storage systems, validated on German and Spanish market data.
